Following this, generator output power adjustment and battery status feedback execute as concurrent RTOS tasks managed by priority queues, with the power adjustment employing a PID controller that iterates until generator output stabilizes. Throughout this sequence, a dedicated watchdog task supervises the startup state machine, and all fault recovery handlers implement exponential backoff with staged verification cycles before any retry attempt.
